versions.changelog:
**Expanded pricing options and major limited-time free trial upgrade.**

- Added detailed subscription and credit package pricing information, including new trial and bonus offers.
- Increased free trial quota from 10 to 200 uses for new users (limited promotion).
- Announced multiple promotional bonus schemes: 20% extra credits on first purchase, up to 30% annual discount, referral rewards.
- Included user testimonials and service statistics for transparency.
- Added new file `scripts/subscription.py` (details not shown).
- Updated documentation structure to focus on value proposition and subscription benefits.

- Added a "Support / 支持" section with an EVM address for user contributions.
- No changes to features or functionality.
- Documentation update only; no impact on skill behavior.

**Major update: Introduced demo mode, trial, drug lookup, and performance/self-evolution scripts.**

- Added demo mode for medication safety review (run without API key).
- Introduced free trial: 10 free safety reviews per user before billing.
- Added built-in drug database with search and listing features.
- Implemented multi-language output (Chinese/English).
- Added performance monitoring and self-evolving scripts.
- Unified environment variable naming for SkillPay integration.

- Added FAQ.md with frequently asked questions for users  
- Added GETTING_STARTED.md to provide step-by-step onboarding instructions  
- Added SECURITY.md outlining security measures and best practices

Version 1.0.2

- Internal code changes in scripts/safety_review.py.
- No updates to user-facing documentation or features.

- Added a README.md file with documentation and usage instructions.
- No changes to application logic or features in this version.

- Initial release of the drug-safety-review skill.
- Provides real-time analysis of drug-drug interactions, contraindications, allergy risks, and dosing optimization.
- Supports 20,000+ FDA-approved medications and over 200,000 documented drug interactions.
- Includes evidence-based recommendations and alternative therapy suggestions.
- Features granular alert severity levels and customizable monitoring recommendations.
- Designed for use by healthcare providers, pharmacists, and patients.
